items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: I know when we were at the Edgewater Gulf Hotel we had to play a lot of this sweet music for dinner music and he used to put the trombone down and pick up the violin

ctx.x: A trombone player's name that we were trying to think of a minute ago was, well now we can't think of it. Frank Netto. Frank Netto. That's right. I see Frank quite frequently and enjoy his playing so much he's still playing. Frank was a musician, a very fine musician. He played not only trombone but he played violin. He played almost any instrument. He was called upon to do it. I know when we were at the Edgewater Gulf Hotel we had to play a lot of this sweet music for dinner music and he used to put the trombone…
Oh Ebby Rao, you're saying you were playing at that chess club?
